Name: Dymaxion
Components: V, S, M (specialized copper-engraved tools worth at least 250 gp)
Description:
You amplify your ability to efficiently manage your magical resources.

For the duration, whenever you cast a 1st-level spell, roll a d20. On a result of 11 or higher, you immediately recover the expended spell slot.

Additionally, whenever you expend a 2nd- or 3rd-level spell slot, you may instead expend a spell slot one level lower.

When the spell ends, you can't cast spells until after your next turn.
